dataList.content:
This was unexpected of you, Faust.
真是意外，浮士德女士。
dataList.place:
Cabins of Mephistopheles

dataList.content:
For you of all Sinners to be the one to bring aboard a 'big shot' to our humble abode.
没想到不同于其他罪人的你，会把“大人物”带来这种简陋的地方。

Tsk, do you have any idea how many times that prick killed us? The least you could do is—
啧，虽然我也没期待着死而复生回来之后能有什么温暖人心的欢迎……

Yes... that reminds me. I'll have to re-open my personal consultation hours for a certain kleptomaniac among us.
这样……看样子需要为手脚不干净的某人再准备一次单独面谈啊。

Vergilius' obvious discontent at the involvement of an outsider didn't seem to bother Faust.
对带回外人一事心有不满的维吉里乌斯的话，浮士德毫不在意。

I considered him indispensable to the completion of this mission.
经判断认为这是需要投入作战中的战力。

And why is that?
理由？

dataList.title:

Because I am the only one who can hunt that Pallid Whale.
因为老夫是唯一可能捕猎那头白鲸的人。

... Of course you are.

The Indigo Elder.
靛蓝老人。

Indigo? He is a Color?! Thou meanest to say that I at this very moment am sharing a space with not one but TWO COLOR FIXERS...?
靛蓝？是特色？吾现在正同两名特色处在同一空间……？

I heard that you were wandering the Great Lake to hunt its Whales.
听说你为了捕鲸，在大湖的某处漂泊。

And last I heard, you hunted one of the five Calamities, the All-impaling Marlin Whale.
根据我最后听说的传闻，你钓上了五大灾害之一的，贯穿一切的马林鲸吧。

dataList.content:
The old man grunted. It was neither a confirmation nor a denial, but that was the way the old man was. Everyone understood that.
虽然是既非肯定也非否定的干咳，但所有人都感觉到，那就是老人的回答。

All circumstantial evidence suggests that the Golden Bough was devoured by the Whale stranded at the Great Lake.
根据现状，金枝被……大湖上游荡的鲸吞食了。

Yes, that very same Pallid Whale of the Five Calamities, normally observed in the Outskirts.
被仅能在郊区观测到的五大灾害之一，那头白鲸。

... Hm. Of course. That's how these things always tend to flow.

为了抓捕那头鲸，您一定经过多年观察，在静候时机的同时掌握了属于自己的方法。

And this is how we'll do it.

The crowd fell silent when Ishmael finished explaining her plan.

... You're mad. All that thrashing's finally sent you off the deep end.

I'm just going there for my mission. And the Golden Bough just happens to be in the same direction.
仅仅因为这是我的目的而已。金枝只是顺便的。

I'll leave it up to you. Well, to the manager, since their decision matters the most.
你们自行决定吧。啊，当然经理的决策才是最重要的。

This Company, me... We're both just trying to find a way to reach our goals. That's all this is.
总之，不论是这家公司还是我，都只是在摸索达成目标的方法罢了。

dataList.content:
This was Ishmael's plan, but... I had no way of knowing what she was really thinking.
虽然是以实玛利自己直接提出的方案，但我不知道她的本意。

I had an inkling, yes. And so far, I've been going along with those vague guesses. Vague guesses that led to disasters.
虽然我隐约有所猜想，但脑海中浮现出许多因胡乱猜测引致灾难的，过往的经历。

So I had to ask her myself.
我只能直接问她。

<Ishmael. What do you really want?>
<以实玛利，你真正期望的到底是什么？>

What I really want...
我的愿望……

I see another vision of Ishmael.
在那个瞬间，我看到了以实玛利的幻觉。

She was hiding it well from the other Sinners and Vergilius. But I could clearly see what she really wanted. Her true desire.
也许是意识到罪人们和维吉里乌斯的存在，她巧妙地掩盖住自己，但那份情感还是十分强烈。

<Ishmael, you...!>
<以实玛利……你……>

She was lifting a body from the waters.
以实玛利正在拾起尸体碎片。

A body that was torn asunder. Shattered bones, strips of muscle tissue, flesh... Ishmael trembled with elation before what looked like the Captain's mutilated corpse.
像是船长的人的骨头和肌肉四散各处，看着那具永远失去意识的身体，她正因满足而浑身颤抖。

What?
怎么了？

Come on, let's get going.
快点走吧。
